caption: The drawing depicts a wooden cabinet with two main sections. The upper section consists of a double-doored cupboard, where the left door is shown open to reveal three interior shelves. The wood grain is detailed, and the coloring is predominantly shades of brown, with hints of reddish and yellowish tones to suggest the natural variations of wood. The right cupboard door remains closed, and both doors have panels outlined with a slightly lighter trim. The lower section features three wide drawers, each with two oval-shaped metal handles and a keyhole at the center. The drawers also display fine wood grain patterns and bordered trim. The cabinet stands on four short bracket feet. The background is a plain, light beige color, and the artist’s signature, "Dorothea A. Farrington," appears in the lower right corner. No other objects or decorations are present in the drawing.
title: Linen Press
